lines.text: If there's one thing I've learned
from this crazy mambo called life,
it's that anyone can be a birthday father, but it takes a heart full of birthdays
to be a true Birthday Dad.
-♪ Got a heart full of birthday-- ♪ -
-Please tell me you guys see that.
